card.name: Start of fib- words (fibrillation, fibrosis)
card.fires_on: The letter F (or 'f' in 'fiber') that begins a split-up word whose next piece is 'ibr' or 'iber', such as atrial fibrillation, nephrogenic systemic fibrosis, fibrinogen and high-fiber foods.
